title: Copper Update- Benchmark Summit 2026 London
gist: This is a member-only video page for Benchmark head of consulting Shruti Kashyap's copper update at Benchmark Summit 2026 London. It gives no prices, balances or forecasts. The related sessions listed cover the Los Azules copper keynote, lithium supply growth, rare earths, Texas Smackover lithium and the UK Critical Minerals Strategy.

insights.claim: Benchmark head of consulting Shruti Kashyap presented a copper market update at Benchmark Summit 2026 London on Oct 22, 2026. The page is member-only and gives no copper prices, balances or forecasts.
insights.speaker: Shruti Kashyap, Head of Consulting, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Benchmark's copper view is not public here, so it cannot be used to adjust copper positioning.

insights.claim: Benchmark Summit 2026 London had a copper keynote on Los Azules, which gives a project-level copper story a slot next to battery-metals sessions.
insights.speaker: Shruti Kashyap, Head of Consulting, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Los Azules is one of the copper projects being marketed to battery and critical-minerals investors.

insights.claim: Benchmark Summit 2026 London had a lithium panel billed as an overview of the market outlook, including supply growth, project development and evolving market dynamics, titled 'The Next Phase of Global Growth'.
insights.speaker: Shruti Kashyap, Head of Consulting, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Framing lithium as entering a 'next phase of global growth' suggests the industry is pitching renewed supply expansion.
insights.quote: An overview of the lithium market outlook, including supply growth, project development, and evolving market dynamics.
insights.locator: Panel Discussion: Lithium Supply, Strategy & Innovation

insights.claim: Benchmark Summit 2026 London had a fireside chat on the UK Critical Minerals Strategy and a keynote asking whether British industry can stay competitive given unpredictable power costs, which puts UK industrial policy at the centre of the event.
insights.speaker: Shruti Kashyap, Head of Consulting, Benchmark
insights.so_what: UK critical-minerals policy and industrial power costs are live themes for UK-based battery and minerals projects.
insights.locator: Fireside Chat: The UK Critical Minerals Strategy

source_meta.author: Shruti Kashyap, Head of Consulting, Benchmark
